design.intent: A Minecraft-like blocky voxel valley with stepped terrain, block trees, and a log cabin, rendered as an 1870s photograph: sepia palette, faded blacks, soft sun shading, vignette corners, and animated film grain.
design.interpretation: Read minecraft as blocky voxel cubes, not trademark assets, and 1870s film style as sepia photographic grade with vignette and grain, not an accurate historical emulsion simulation.
assumptions: Host owns core:NullGraph, canvas, camera, and frame loop.
No GLB, texture, network, or font assets are loaded.
One Lambert batch draws all voxel cubes from 14-float instances.
Voxel map is precomputed once on CPU and stays static.
1870s look is sepia grade plus vignette and animated grain.
Lighting is standard forward with one sun plus ambient fill.

design.motion: World is static except for animated film grain from camera time and a very slow host camera drift. No character, water, or physics motion. Flicker-free, still-photo feel.

techniques.purpose: One cube mesh drawn thousands of times with per-instance position, scale, and color for grass, dirt, stone, wood, leaves.
Single warm directional sun plus ambient and hemisphere fill for soft 1870s daylight on Lambert diffuse.
Sepia grade before tonemap, then vignette and animated grain after tonemap for aged-photo finish.

resourceFlow: CPU voxel map builds 14-float instance array
Instance array streams to Lambert batch storage via updateBatchData
Cube geometry uploads once and binds to batch
LightSystem uploads sun plus ambient to group 2
Scene pass renders cubes into PostChain color attachments
PostChain runs ColorGrade then Tonemap then Vignette then FilmGrain to screen
design.cameraAndTiming: Host holds a slow low orbital drift across the voxel valley, eye ~28m out, looking at village center. Still-photograph pacing, ~30s loop, no fast action.

controls.effect: Adjust sepia warmth and fade without rebuild.
controls.name: Sepia grade

successCriteria: Terrain, trees, and cabin read as unit cubes in one frame.
Palette is brown-sepia with desaturated greens.
Sun side is lit and shadow side is readable, not black.
Corners are visibly darker from vignette.
Fine grain is visible on sky and flat blocks.
No bright neon color or modern PBR gloss.
unresolved: True scratches, dust, sprocket holes, and flicker need custom WGSL beyond stock post effects, so only grain and vignette are planned.
Accurate 1870s lens softness and orthochromatic response have no stock control and are approximated with grade.

init: Build voxel map, fill 14-float instances, upload geometry and batch data, set lights, setChain in canonical order

objects.purpose: Offscreen scene pass feeding PostChain attachments.
Unit cube shared by every voxel block.
Lambert batch drawing all voxel instances.
Cheap diffuse material with per-instance color.
Warm sun plus ambient fill bound at group 2.
Sepia desaturation and warm grade before tonemap.
Chain compiling grade, tonemap, vignette, grain in canonical order.
